findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：部分關鍵原料向政經情勢可能不穩的國家的供應商採購，且供應商漲價或無法供貨時可能沒有替代來源；未點名國家，也未揭露特定單一來源供應商
findings.excerpt: In some cases, these critical raw materials and supplies are purchased from suppliers operating in countries that may be subject to unstable political and economic conditions.

findings.claim: 10-K 風險因子：供應商漲價或不願／無法滿足需求時，公司可能沒有替代供應來源
findings.excerpt: If suppliers increase the price of critical raw materials or are unwilling or unable to meet our demand, we may not have alternative sources of supply.

findings.claim: 3Q26 財報簡報前瞻聲明風險因子：取得能源或原料的能力，特別是來自政經情勢可能不穩國家的供應商，以及關稅與勞資糾紛
findings.excerpt: (3) the ability to recoup increases in the cost of energy, raw materials, freight or other factors; (4) domestic and foreign excess manufacturing capacity for certain metals; (5) fluctuations in currency exchange and interest rates; (6) the effect of government trade actions, including tariffs;
